title: [Mechanisms of 6-Hydroxygen Genistein in the Treatment of Pulmonary Injury in High-Altitude Hypoxic Mice].
authors: Ma, Chuan; Wang, Xiaojuan; Yang, Chenyu; Zhang, Shuyu; Yang, Baole; Jing, Linlin; Ma, Huiping
journal: Sichuan da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Sichuan University. Medical science edition
one_liner_zh: 该文研究6-羟基染料木素治疗高原缺氧肺损伤的机制，涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the mechanisms of 6-hydroxygenistein (6-OHG) in the treatment of high-altitude hypoxia-induced lung injury. METHODS: The intersection targets of 6-OHG and high-altitude hypoxia-induced lung injury were identified using databases, including Swiss Target Prediction, SuperPred, GeneCards, and OMIM. The STRING database and Cytoscape software were used to construct a protein interaction network for the intersection targets of drugs and diseases, and targets with degree values greater than the median were identified as key targets. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of key targets were performed using the DAVID database to identify relevant signaling pathways. The Maestro 13.7 software was used for molecular docking validation. A large hypobaric hypoxic chamber was used to establish a high-altitude lung injury model in mice. A total of 42 male BALB/c mice were randomly assigned to 3 groups (n = 14 in each group), including a normal control group, which was exposed to the environmental conditions at the altitude of 1400 m and received a single intraperitoneal injection of normal saline, a model group, which received a single intraperitoneal injection of normal saline, and a 6-OHG group, which received a single intraperitoneal injection of 6-OHG at 100 mg/kg. Then, 1 h after drug administration, mice in the model and 6-OHG groups were placed in a large hypobaric hypoxic simulation chamber for animal experiments. Then, they ascended to an altitude of 8000 m at a speed of 10 m/s, remained in that environment for 24 h, and then descended to an altitude of 3500 m. Mice in the three groups were sacrificed, and their lung tissues were extracted to measure the water content in the lungs. Pathological changes were observed using HE staining, and the levels of malondialdehyde (MDA), H2O2, total superoxide dismutase (T-SOD), and glutathione (GSH) were measured. Western blot was performed to determine the expression levles of p-PI3K/PI3K, p-AKT/AKT, hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha), and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) proteins. RESULTS: Key targets such as serine/threonine protein kinase 1 (AKT1), HIF-1alpha, epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), matrix metalloproteinase 9 (MMP9), and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor A (PPARA) were identified. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses showed that the targets of 6-OHG in the treatment of high altitude hypoxia-induced lung injury were mainly involved in PI3K/AKT, HIF-1alpha/VEGF, tumor necrosis factor (TNF), and other signaling pathways. The results of animal experiments demonstrated that compared with the model group, the 6-OHG group showed significant improvement in the pathological damage of lung tissues induced by high altitude hypoxia, presenting statistically significant differences in the levels of MDA, H(2)O(2), GSH, and T-SOD (P < 0.01). The results of Western blot assay revealed statistically significant differences in the p-PI3K/PI3K, p-AKT/AKT, HIF-1alpha, and VEGF levels in the lung tissues of the 6-OHG group compared with those of the model group (P < 0.01). The molecular docking results showed that 6-OHG could form stable binding with PI3K, AKT, HIF-1alpha, and VEGF. CONCLUSION: 6-OHG may alleviate lung injury induced by high altitude hypoxia in mice by activating the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway and inhibiting the HIF/VEGF signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨6-羟基染料木素（6-OHG）治疗高原低氧性肺损伤的机制。方法：利用Swiss Target Prediction、SuperPred、GeneCards和OMIM等数据库，筛选6-OHG与高原低氧性肺损伤的交集靶点。采用STRING数据库和Cytoscape软件构建药物与疾病交集靶点的蛋白质相互作用网络，并将度值大于中位数的靶点确定为核心靶点。利用DAVID数据库对核心靶点进行GO和KEGG富集分析，以识别相关信号通路。使用Maestro 13.7软件进行分子对接验证。采用大型低压低氧舱建立小鼠高原肺损伤模型。共42只雄性BALB/c小鼠随机分为3组（每组n=14），包括正常对照组（暴露于海拔1400 m环境条件，单次腹腔注射生理盐水）、模型组（单次腹腔注射生理盐水）和6-OHG组（单次腹腔注射100 mg/kg的6-OHG）。给药1 h后，将模型组和6-OHG组小鼠置于大型低压低氧模拟舱中进行动物实验，以10 m/s的速度上升至海拔8000 m，在该环境中停留24 h，然后下降至海拔3500 m。处死三组小鼠，提取肺组织，测定肺含水量。采用HE染色观察病理变化，并测定丙二醛（MDA）、H2O2、总超氧化物歧化酶（T-SOD）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平。采用Western blot检测p-PI3K/PI3K、p-AKT/AKT、缺氧诱导因子1α（HIF-1α）和血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）蛋白的表达水平。结果：鉴定出核心靶点，如丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶1（AKT1）、HIF-1α、表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）、基质金属蛋白酶9（MMP9）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体A（PPARA）。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，6-OHG治疗高原低氧性肺损伤的靶点主要涉及PI3K/AKT、HIF-1α/VEGF、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）等信号通路。动物实验结果表明，与模型组相比，6-OHG组高原低氧诱导的肺组织病理损伤显著改善，MDA、H2O2、GSH和T-SOD水平差异具有统计学意义（P < 0.01）。Western blot结果显示，与模型组相比，6-OHG组肺组织中p-PI3K/PI3K、p-AKT/AKT、HIF-1α和VEGF水平差异具有统计学意义（P < 0.01）。分子对接结果显示，6-OHG能与PI3K、AKT、HIF-1α和VEGF形成稳定结合。结论：6-OHG可能通过激活PI3K/AKT信号通路并抑制HIF/VEGF信号通路，减轻小鼠高原低氧诱导的肺损伤。
